question: Who was conferred with the prestigious Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS) Humanitarian Award 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nita M. Ambani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Nita M. Ambani, Founder and Chairperson of Reliance Foundation, was honored with the KISS Humanitarian Award 2025 in Bhubaneswar.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Recognition:** The award acknowledges her work in education, healthcare, rural transformation, women empowerment, and sports.
 
• **Presenter:** The honor was presented by Nobel Laureate Prof. Mohan Munasinghe from Sri Lanka.
 
• **Dedication:** Smt. Ambani dedicated the award to the entire team of the **Reliance Foundation**.
 
• **History of the Award:** Initiated in 2008 by Dr. Achyuta Samanta, it is the highest honor of the Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS).
 
• **Symbolism:** The trophy features a **"golden heart"** being uplifted by a pair of hands, symbolizing kindness and the transformation of underprivileged lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• KISS and KIIT__

 
 
• Based in Odisha, the Kalinga Institute of Social Sciences (KISS) is the world's largest residential institute for tribal children, providing free education, accommodation, and healthcare to over 30,000 students.
